title: Heun Spectrum, Threshold Hierarchy, and One-Loop Quantum Mass of the Christ--Lee Kink
summary: We study the fluctuation spectrum and renormalized one-loop quantum mass of the Christ--Lee kink over the full positive range of its deformation parameter. The fluctuation equation is reduced exactly to general-Heun form, yielding parity-resolved continuum solutions and implicit quantization conditions for the discrete spectrum. At the first nontrivial continuum crossing, the odd Heun solution truncates to a polynomial, giving the exact threshold \(ε_1=\sqrt{\sqrt{3}-1}\).
